top_signals.title: Cash-strapped Japanese monks turn to investing as inflation worsens
top_signals.summary: A growing wave of temple owners turning to financial markets as costs for the upkeep are soaring and the country's Buddhist population is falling.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Trump says Kennedy Center will stay closed without renovation unless his name is added back
top_signals.summary: The ruling comes four months after the same judge ordered that the Kennedy Center could not be renamed to include President Trump's name.
